title: EEG and hedonic responses to sonic-seasoning soundscapes
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings and hedonic (liking) ratings collected from participants exposed to sonic-seasoning soundscapes. Each participant has a combined recording with eyes-open and eyes-closed baselines followed by roughly 17 s exposures to jungle and deconstruct soundscapes. Liking ratings and baseline-state survey items are included in participants.tsv, and the stimulus audio is provided. An EEGLAB-ready processed version is provided as a derivative.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with an EPOC X headset, with hardware bandpass filtering only and no additional software filtering. Each session included eyes-open and eyes-closed calibration segments, which were advanced by a participant-controlled button press, so their durations vary. These were followed by about 17 s exposures to the jungle and deconstruct soundscapes. Liking ratings and baseline-state survey items were collected from each participant.
